questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Pre-production?

options.text: It is the planning phase before filming, covering script, casting, and scheduling.
It is the principal phase in which the film is actually photographed.
It is the phase after filming covering editing, sound, colour, and effects.
It is a sequence of drawings that plans each shot before filming begins.

questions.explanation: It is the planning phase before filming, covering script, casting, and scheduling. This is precisely what Pre-production means; the alternatives describe Production, Post-production, Storyboard, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Pre-production.

provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used
